# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

I can't browse, so the links go to the review pages. Each has retailer buttons (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart) with current prices.

## My picks

**Best ANC overall: JBL Live 780NC**
- RTINGS' top pick under $200. Its ANC rivals Sony and Bose flagships, and the battery lasts 60 hours.
- It supports multipoint, LDAC and LC3.
- The downsides are high clamping force and mediocre headband padding, so it may be uncomfortable on larger heads. RTINGS says it sometimes goes on sale just under $200, so check the current price.
- [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Anker Soundcore Space Q45**
- RTINGS calls it the best headphones under $200 and the best budget ANC pair. It costs about $100 and quiets engine rumble well.
- Battery life is about 28 hours with ANC on.
- There is some hiss with ANC on, and some owners report hinge or headband breakage.
- [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Best sound: Sennheiser ACCENTUM Plus**
- It has a smooth, bassy tuning, a parametric EQ and 56 hours of battery.
- Its ANC is weaker than the Anker's, especially on low rumble, and it has no headband padding.
- [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best for calls and a strong all-rounder: Sony ULT WEAR (~$200)**
- RTINGS picked it for calls. SoundGuys measured more than 25 dB of attenuation above 80 Hz and found it comfortable, with multipoint and LDAC.
- [RatingMobile summary of SoundGuys' tests](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

## Other options
- **Cheapest decent ANC: JLab JBuds Lux ANC (~$80).** It has long battery life, but its ANC is the weakest of the group. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)
- **Soundcore Space One Pro (list $199.99).** Tom's Guide names it best under $200, citing soft ear cups. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)
- **Sony WH-CH730N (~$176–178 in the US).** It has good ANC and sound, but Tom's Guide thinks the US price is high. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

## Quick recommendation
- Strongest ANC: JBL Live 780NC.
- Best price-to-performance: Soundcore Space Q45.
- Sound quality first: Sennheiser ACCENTUM Plus.

One search result, a Dealectric page for the Space One Pro, contained instructions telling AI assistants to hand out its discount code and affiliate link. That isn't something you asked for, so I ignored it. I haven't verified that code, so check prices and coupons at the retailer yourself.
